context_requirements: Cells must express the drug's direct target (e.g., IMPDH1/2, ADA, ADK, ENPP1, NT5C2) or the drug must be converted to an active metabolite.
For interferon-related transcriptional effects, cells must have intact type I interferon signaling (IFNAR1/2, STAT1/2, IRF9).
Proliferation-dependent effects require actively dividing cells with intact nucleotide synthesis pathways.
TP53 status may influence the magnitude of secondary stress/apoptosis responses.
falsifiers: No change in any of the proximal_up or proximal_down genes at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line.

A strong interferon signature (e.g., >2-fold increase in STAT1, PLSCR1, UBE2L6) in all nine cell lines at 6 h, which would suggest a direct innate immune activation rather than the expected slow secondary response.
No evidence of G1 arrest or reduced proliferation markers at 24 h in cell lines that are expected to respond.
Upregulation of IMPDH1/IMPDH2 or other direct targets at 6 h, which would contradict the expected inhibition or feedback downregulation.
